accordion.how_to_install_answer: Add coui_flutter to your pubspec.yaml dependencies and run flutter pub get to install the package.
accordion.is_customizable_answer: Yes! CoUI Flutter provides extensive theming support allowing you to customize colors, typography, spacing and more via ThemeData.
accordion.getting_started_answer: Start by installing the package and importing it into your project. Refer to the documentation for detailed setup instructions.
accordion.features_answer: CoUI Flutter includes buttons, forms, dialogs, navigation components and more. All components are designed with accessibility and theming in mind.
accordion.support_answer: For questions or support, visit our GitHub repository or check the documentation at docs.coui.dev.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.lead: Beautifully designed components from Coui/UI are now available in Flutter.
introduction.welcome_paragraph_1: coui_flutter is a diverse and comprehensive set of UI components specifically designed for Flutter desktop and web applications. As the popularity of Flutter for building cross-platform apps increases, we recognized the need for a toolkit that highlights the unique design requirements of desktop and web interfaces.
introduction.welcome_paragraph_2: This package provides a wide range of customizable and responsive components that adhere to modern desktop and web design principles. Whether you're building sophisticated business applications, polished dashboards, or productivity tools, our components are designed to help you create professional and sleek UIs quickly and efficiently.

features_list.material_cupertino: Supports Material and Cupertino widgets and themes are currently tailored to the coui_flutter theme.
features_list.platform_support: Support for mobile, web, and desktop platforms.

introduction.notes_paragraph_1: This package is still in development and may have future changes. Please exercise caution when using this package in production.
introduction.notes_paragraph_2: This package is not affiliated with Coui/UI. It is a community-driven project.
